headline: Sensex snaps two-day fall, gains 333 points above 23,200
why: Positive global cues driven by trade hopes from Trump-Xi meeting.
Strong buying interest in metals and FMCG stocks ahead of Fed decision.
Cooling volatility as India VIX dropped by 3%.
whatHappening: Sensex rose over 330 points while Nifty reclaimed the 23,200 level.
Hero Motors IPO concluded Day 3 with a 4.29x subscription status.
Merchants will face a 0.4% charge on UPI transactions over ₹2,000.
Bank of Japan hiked interest rates to a 31-year high to fight inflation.

stocksInNews.sources: Apple Pay reported to be eyeing India rollout in partnership with Axis Bank
Shares rose 2% after Bernstein noted a clearer path for its ALS drug
Hero Motors IPO subscribed 4.29 times on its third day
IT sector dragged market gains ahead of the US Fed interest rate decision

summary: Indian benchmark indices bounced back after a two-day decline, supported by metals, FMCG, and optimistic global cues. Key stock developments included Axis Bank's potential Apple Pay deal and Zydus Life's drug pipeline boost.
